# grepr_newrelic_integration (Resource)

Manages a New Relic integration. Keys are always validated with New Relic when saved. Secrets are written through dedicated endpoints after the integration is saved. They are sensitive but stored in Terraform state. They are write-only: the API never returns them, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Removing a secret from the configuration stops managing it without deleting it remotely. If a secret is rejected while the integration is being created, Terraform marks the integration tainted; run `terraform untaint` and apply again to retry the secret without replacing the integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "newrelic_license_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "grepr_newrelic_integration" "main" {
  name        = "production_newrelic"
  site        = "newrelic.com"
  license_key = var.newrelic_license_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name.
- `site` (String) New Relic site. Must be one of the organization's allowed sites.

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) New Relic account ID.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) User API key used to read from New Relic.
- `dashboard_freshness_window` (String) Import only dashboards viewed within this ISO-8601 duration, written in the server's form such as `PT672H` for 28 days, its default; another spelling shows as a change. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `license_key` (String, Sensitive) License key used to send logs to New Relic.
- `private_link` (Boolean) Connect through AWS PrivateLink. The server defaults it to `false`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs with access. Omit to keep the current teams; an empty set clears them.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Integration version used for optimistic locking.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grepr_newrelic_integration.main INTEGRATION_ID
```
